_note: GeoUltra first-look video: one line per scene (draft for the user, 2026-11-14). Spoken by Piper voice Alba; spelled for TTS where needed. User 2026-11-14: a sneak peek (the repository stays private until the release), 'aims to run'.
title: GeoUltra. A GEOS compatible system for the Ultimate sixty-four. A sneak peek at version zero point one, in development.
boot: GeoUltra boots from a cartridge on the Ultimate sixty-four. It is a new, clean-room GEOS compatible system: it aims to run existing GEOS applications, and uses the Ultimate for its drives, its memory and its network.
desktop: This is GeoUltra's own desktop. On the left, the drives, the Ultimate's own storage, favourites and recent documents. On the right, the current folder.
views: Three views: a list, icons from the files' own GEOS headers, and a detailed view with sizes and dates. Themes change the colours, and on the Ultimate sixty-four even the palette.
panes: Two panes show two folders side by side. Each pane has its own drive letters, and the U button reaches the Ultimate's USB sticks and SD card.
drag: Files are dragged from one pane to the other. A GEOS file copied to the Ultimate becomes a C V T file, and comes back as a GEOS file the other way.
geowrite: Existing applications run here too. In this example geoWrite starts from a folder on a large native drive, and its Open dialog lists the folders.
geofolder: From any application's GEOS menu, geoFolder changes the current folder of each drive.
gush: Gush is GeoUltra's shell: a command line with many commands, scripts, pipes, and network tools such as wget and N T P time.
settings: GeoUltra Settings edits the desktop, the system, the time, the mouse pointer, and the themes, with a live preview and the palette in R G B.
closing: GeoUltra is in development and will be free, under the G P L, at its first release. Made with the help of Claude, an A I from Anthropic. Thanks for watching.
